name: When is custom cabinetry worth the extra cost in a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: When is custom cabinetry worth the extra cost in a kitchen remodel?
mainEntity.text: When is custom cabinetry worth the extra cost in a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinetry is worth the extra cost when standard cabinet sizes cannot solve the layout or design problem cleanly. This happens often in older Los Angeles homes, where walls may be uneven, ceiling heights vary, or the kitchen must fit around existing structural conditions. Custom cabinets are also valuable when the homeowner wants integrated appliances, hidden storage, furniture-style details, or a seamless built-in appearance. If the kitchen is small, custom cabinetry can improve storage efficiency enough to justify the higher price. If the kitchen is large and straightforward, semi-custom may deliver a better value. The decision should also account for how long the homeowner plans to stay in the property, because custom millwork can improve daily function and resale appeal in high-end neighborhoods. A good rule is to spend on custom cabinetry when it solves a real spatial or aesthetic problem, not just because it sounds premium.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinetry is worth the extra cost when the kitchen has an awkward layout, needs special storage, has very tall ceilings, or must match a high-end architectural style. It also makes sense when standard cabinet sizes would waste space or break the design.
